observations: Single photo shows one solar panel leaning against a wall near a glass door
Panel has dark monocrystalline-style cells with visible cell gridlines and a half-cut cell layout (split by a horizontal bar mid-panel)
A faint watermark reads 'INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP' across the panel surface - this appears to be a photo-stamp/watermark, not a label on the panel itself
No visible manufacturer label, wattage sticker, or spec plate on the frame or back of the panel
No junction box, cables, or back sheet shown
Only one angle/photo provided, no close-up of any rating label
Seller text is a generic promotional line ('Contact us for ur Solar Energy Solution') with no specifications given

claims.claim: Solar Energy Solution (implied the panel is a functional solar product for sale)
claims.evidence: No wattage, brand, or spec label visible in photo 0; no performance demonstration shown

risks.risk: Wattage/power rating unknown, which drives most of the price for a solar panel
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating label/sticker (usually on the back of the panel) showing Wp, Voc, Isc
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, as price ranges for panels of different wattages vary too widely for a single worst-case figure

risks.risk: Panel could be used, damaged, or have hidden micro-cracks not visible in a single front-angle photo
risks.proof: Close-up shots of all four corners, the back junction box, and any visible cracks under raking light
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/unverified condition, not new

risks.risk: Brand/manufacturer unverified, affects resale value and warranty
risks.proof: Clear photo of manufacturer nameplate or back label

risks.risk: Quantity being sold unclear (single unit vs lot) since seller speaks generally of 'solar energy solution'
risks.proof: Seller confirms number of units and photos of all units together
risks.if_unproven: priced as single unit only, as shown

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the back-of-panel rating label showing wattage (Wp), Voc, Isc, and model number
Photo of manufacturer brand/nameplate on the frame or back sheet
Photos of all four corners and back junction box to check for cracks or damage
Confirmation of how many panels are included in this listing
response.reason: The single photo shows a solar panel but no wattage, brand, or spec label is readable anywhere, and wattage is the primary price driver for solar panels, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without that label.
